Title: QUESTION: Sabbat Threat and the Edge

Messages.Author: ni...@rci.rogers.com
Messages.Body:
Is there a specific time when you're allowed to sacrifice the Edge to get rid
of all your Sabbat Threat counters? Or can you sacrifice the Edge at any time
to do this?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:


You can sacrifice (burn) the Edge at any time to lose your Threat
counters.

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@regency.wizards.com)
Official VtES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.
(*) - Subject to review by Rules Team

Messages.Author: JohannM555
Messages.Body:
My group has used the "any time" rule.
e.g. A malkav deck has a sabbat threat counter. On his turn one malkav
successfully bleeds, and gives up the edge to remove the counter. Then
another malkav successfully bleeds, regaining the edge.

Messages.Author: Dave Green
Messages.Body:
JohannM555 (johan...@aol.com) wrote:
: My group has used the "any time" rule.

: e.g. A malkav deck has a sabbat threat counter. On his turn one malkav
: successfully bleeds, and gives up the edge to remove the counter. Then
: another malkav successfully bleeds, regaining the edge.

Or even:
You have the edge and a threat counter. If it is your untap,
you can gain blood from the edge, then burn it to lose the
counter before paying for it. If it isn't your turn, and
someone declares a bleed which you think will be successful,
give up the edge before the bleed is successful to lose the
counter. Sabbat threat is only a problem if you can't get the
edge.
